Maya (CSM): Heads up — SableWorks pilot usage dropped ~80% last week. Embed and generate endpoints are flat. New Head of Data (Olivia) started two weeks ago; procurement is asking about on‑prem options after seeing another vendor demo. Need triage before renewal. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/sableworks/usage?range=7d
Sam (Solutions Eng): On it. Any red errors in logs or just traffic drop? can you paste the last 7d qps/tokens?
Maya (CSM): quick snapshot:
```
last_7d_tokens_per_day: 12000 -> 2300
active_seats: 15 -> 6
top_routes: /embed (70%), /generate (20%), /rerank (10%)
``` 
Jordan (RevOps): Renewal date is 42 days out, procurement wants pricing and SLA options. we should move fast.
Lia (CS Ops): Suggest offering a 6-week Dedicated trial with a performance SLA + short acceptance criteria. Also schedule a QBR with Olivia and Proc.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll build a 1-pager perf vs cost comparison and include KV-cache + quantization recommendations — might recover 30-40% cost for their embed-heavy workload.
Maya (CSM): customer quote: "their demo emphasized on-prem tail latency and deterministic throughput." they said it's a hard ask from procurement.
deploy-bot: created template /templates/dedicated-trial-brief
Jordan (RevOps): I'll tentatively book Tue 10am PT for QBR, invite: Olivia (Head of Data), Alex (CTO), procurement rep. @Maya confirm?
Maya (CSM): confirmed. Action items:
- Sam: perf + cost deck by EOD Fri
- Lia: draft trial extension + acceptance criteria
- Jordan: calendar + commercial prep
- Maya: send usage snapshot + customer quote to stakeholders
Sam (Solutions Eng): quick SQL I ran: `SELECT date, tokens FROM usage WHERE account='sableworks' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 7;` will include raw numbers in deck.
Lia (CS Ops): Draft acceptance criteria: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 700ms on /embed, retention >= 75% of previous pilot activity, no catastrophic errors for 7 consecutive days.
Maya (CSM): if we pair Dedicated trial + 10% trial discount + clear acceptance criteria, procurement likely to engage. :thumbsup:
Jordan (RevOps): Agree. I'll prep fallback commercial terms if they still ask for on‑prem (migration planning + timeline).
Sam (Solutions Eng): uploaded draft deck: https://redwood.app/drafts/sableworks-perf-deck
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone — marking as priority. I'll post updates after the QBR invite is accepted. :exclamation:
Sam (Solutions Eng): noted, will add quantization config and KV cache toggles in appendix.
Maya (CSM): perfect, thanks :heart:
